jobs.title: Game Developer
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Game Developer
to join our Development team
. You'll work closely with Product Managers and Artists, and play a key role in building and optimizing gameplay experiences that are fun, smooth, and engaging from the ground up.

At Agave Games, we create games that reach and inspire millions of players around the world. We’re a passionate, product-driven studio with a sharp focus on quality, creativity, and player satisfaction.

Requirements

Experience with C# and Unity game engine
Strong understanding of game mechanics and player experience
Passion for mobile games and player-centric design
Creative problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach
Ability to analyze games and translate insights into improvements
Team player who values collaboration and open feedback
Nice to have: experience developing or launching mobile games

Responsibilities

Design, implement, and test gameplay features
Develop high-quality, maintainable, and scalable game code
Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering teams
Analyze gameplay and suggest improvements to enhance player experience
Contribute creative ideas to improve game mechanics and features
Optimize gameplay performance and ensure a smooth user experience
Stay up to date with trends and best practices in mobile game development

Life at Agave

Private health insurance
All-day meals and healthy snacks at the office, prepared by professional chefs
Free access to the on-site gym to support a healthy lifestyle
Relocation support is provided when needed
Continuous learning and professional development opportunities
Fun and inclusive team events and activities
Centrally located office in Istanbul with easy access to public transportation

jobs.title: Senior .NET Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Brainsquare

Brainsquare designs, develops, integrates and manages business-critical applications. We combine technical expertise with a practical understanding of our customers’ operations, helping teams build and maintain reliable software.

Your mission

As a Senior .NET Software Engineer, you will join an experienced development team working on business-critical applications in Antwerp.

You will design and develop backend components and REST APIs using C# and .NET 8. Working within the existing architecture, you will translate requirements into reliable, maintainable solutions and take ownership of your work from technical design through implementation.

This long-term assignment combines hands-on development with close collaboration. You will contribute to technical decisions, share your expertise and help the team deliver high-quality software.

Your main tasks

Take ownership of the technical design and development of backend components.
Develop and maintain REST APIs using C# and .NET 8.
Implement data access with Entity Framework and work with SQL databases.
Apply SOLID principles, Clean Architecture and dependency injection to deliver maintainable code.
Investigate technical issues and translate findings into practical solutions.
Collaborate with the technical lead and other team members on implementation choices and integration requirements.
Contribute to code quality through reviews, unit testing and automated testing practices.
Communicate progress, technical decisions and delivery risks clearly.

What we are looking for in you

Strong hands-on experience in .NET development, preferably as a senior developer or technical lead.
Proven experience building REST APIs with C# and .NET 8.
Practical experience with Entity Framework.
A solid understanding of SOLID principles, Clean Architecture and dependency injection.
Solid SQL knowledge.
The ability to take responsibility for both technical design and implementation.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Clear communication and a proactive approach to working with colleagues.
Fluent English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.
Availability for a long-term assignment in Antwerp.
Availability to work on site in Antwerp three days per week, combined with two days of remote work.

Experience with Git, unit testing and automated testing practices, particularly xUnit, is preferred.

Familiarity with microservices architecture and cloud-based solutions, particularly Microsoft Azure, is a plus.

What we offer to employees

As a Brainsquare employee, you will work alongside experienced technical colleagues and have opportunities to develop your expertise. We will discuss the employment arrangement, salary, benefits and mobility options based on your situation and the assignment.

What we offer to freelancers

As a freelancer, you can expect a focused assignment, a clear technical briefing and direct communication throughout the selection process and collaboration. You will join an established team with a concrete need for additional development capacity.

Why choose Brainsquare?

You will contribute to software that supports an industrial business environment, with room to take ownership of backend design and development. The assignment combines hands-on engineering with close collaboration in an existing technical team.

Interested?

Apply with your CV and indicate your earliest availability.

Openings: 2

Employment Type: Payroll, Freelance

Experience level: Senior Professional

jobs.title: Web Application Developer (Vue, Angular, .NET, Data Pipelines) for NATO with security clearance
jobs.description:
The analysts have the numbers. You build what makes senior leaders actually read them.

A data analysis team at an international defence organisation in Brussels needs a developer who can turn data from many sources into clean web applications and dashboards for senior leadership. The work is mostly remote, with a handful of visits to Brussels.

What You Would Be Doing

Designing, building and deploying web applications and dashboards with modern front-end frameworks
Bringing data from classified and unclassified sources into those systems, with Python and ETL tooling doing the conversion and preparation
Extending the team's data collection tools in line with what stakeholders ask for, and testing them with the people who use them
Building dashboards for leadership in Python or Power BI
Documenting code, endpoints and architecture, writing training material and handing knowledge over to staff
Supporting security testing and approval, reporting progress and flagging risks to the timeline early

What you would bring

At least 5 years of web development in JavaScript and HTML with React, Vue.js or Angular
Extensive MS SQL experience; .NET is an advantage
Python for automation, ETL and analysis (pandas, numpy, matplotlib) and experience building backend services or pipelines
Dashboards built for senior stakeholders in Python and/or Power BI
Git, Agile ways of working and a bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, IT or similar
Advanced English and clear, confident communication

Why this one is worth a look

Your work lands directly in front of senior decision-makers, the pattern is largely remote, and it sits under a standing framework rather than a one-off project.
